name: nova-share
description: High-Throughput, Zero-Corruption Cross-Platform Backup & File Transfer Engine (Windows Laptop -> Linux Omarchy PC)

scripts.build:windows: bun run build:ui && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist/novashare-windows.exe
scripts.build:linux: bun run build:ui && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/novashare-linux

author: Rhea Takahashi
